latHint: Think what a pepper mill does to peppercorns.
pivHint: The psalmist praises the God who DAILY bears our burdens. The tiresome routine of working life is called the DAILY ______.
winText: You found it. DAILY isn't just how often God bears our burdens. The tiresome routine of working life is called the DAILY GRIND.
lossText: The word was GRIND. DAILY was the pivot. The DAILY GRIND is a phrase for the tiring, repetitive routine of everyday work.
votdVerse: Praise be to the Lord, to God our Savior, who daily bears our burdens.
passageText: Praise be to the Lord, to God our Savior, who daily bears our burdens. I removed the burden from their shoulders; their hands were set free from the basket. My guilt has overwhelmed me like a burden too heavy to bear.
